snippet.title: Space Station Roguelite - Devlog 3 - Maps, Modules, Missiles
snippet.description:
This is the third devlog for a roguelite about jumping a small fleet of ark ships from star system to star system, building temporary stations to survive, and trying to stay ahead of a terrible energy-harvesting Swarm.

---

Links
📬 Newsletter: https://tinyurl.com/msckjs2h
🎨 Concept Artist: Matt https://www.artstation.com/mattruszala
🚀 Battlestar Inspo (2:15-2:46 https://youtu.be/cijhXMILMf4?t=136

---

In this video:
- Star classifications: filter by spectral type and luminosity to plan your next few jumps.
- Module systems: Modules now define a collection of systems, each with a different effect on the state of your station. Here we see power, thermal, storage, docking.
- Thermal management: visualise how heat flows across your station. Try to keep it from stressing systems and crew.
- Missile & beam defenses: counter the Swarm using limited ordnance. 

It’s been a full month; there's been lots of progress, a couple of bugs, and a first look at early concepts for the game’s key art and posters.

I believe I'm still on track for playtesting in December, but before that I need to decide on a final name... Got any ideas? Drop your suggestions in the comments.
